description: Private-by-default Git history, CodeLens and interactive rebase editor.
codeLens: Show the latest author above functions and classes.
gravatar: Fetch Gravatar avatars. Sends SHA-256 email hashes to Gravatar when enabled.
repositoriesWelcome: Open a folder containing a Git repository.\n[Open Commit Graph](command:gitInsights.openGraph)
blame: Show current-line blame annotations and commit details on hover.
gitlabProjectUrl: HTTPS project URL for self-hosted GitLab, including the namespace, optional web port and base path. Set this per workspace folder. Used for unrecognized origin hosts; GitHub.com, GitLab.com and Bitbucket.org keep automatic links. Leave empty to disable. No credentials, query or fragment.
gitlabProjectUrlError: Enter an HTTPS project URL including its namespace and project, without credentials, query or fragment, or leave empty.
